one_line: Architect Sutradhar Jaita presents designs for the Vijay Stambha to his patron, Maharana Kumbha of Mewar, at Chittor in mid-15th century Rajasthan.

appearance.age_look: Jaita appears as a wiry man in his mid-40s; Maharana Kumbha as a broad-shouldered warrior-king in his early 30s.
appearance.face: Jaita has an oval face, wheatish complexion, neat trimmed mustache and sharp, thoughtful eyes with a calm, focused expression; Kumbha has a square jaw, slightly deeper brown complexion, full mustache, short beard, and a steady, commanding yet composed expression.
appearance.hair: Jaita’s black hair is medium-length and pulled back into a low knot under a simple off-white turban with a thin red border; Kumbha’s black hair is tied in a short warrior’s knot beneath a red Rajput turban (pagri) with a golden band and a single modest white feather tucked on the left side.
appearance.costume: Sutradhar Jaita wears a long off-white cotton angarkha tied diagonally, with a faint cream stripe weave, over a light mustard-yellow cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles, a simple brown woven cloth belt, and a soft, loose cream cotton shawl with a thin red edge over one shoulder; he is barefoot or in simple brown leather sandals, with minimal jewellery—just a small copper bangle on his right wrist. Maharana Kumbha wears a rich but practical mid-15th century Rajput ruler’s outfit: a knee-length deep maroon quilted cotton coat (zibhā or padded angarkhi) with subtle vertical quilting and gold piping at edges, layered over a pale ivory cotton kurta; a deep green cotton jama-style lower garment flaring to mid-calf over off-white churidar-style tight trousers; a broad dark brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle and small knife sheath; and soft brown leather boots reaching mid-calf with a slight curve at the toe. Over his shoulders is a light ochre woolen shawl with a thin green border, draped to leave his sword arm free. He wears a simple gold kada on each wrist, a thin gold chain with a small round pendant, and understated gold stud earrings.
appearance.signature: Sutradhar Jaita carries a rolled palm-leaf architectural plan and a slender wooden measuring rod tucked into his belt, while Maharana Kumbha carries a slightly curved Rajput talwar in a plain brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, worn at his left hip and often resting lightly in his hand.

ref_desc: A mid-40s wiry architect, Sutradhar Jaita, in off-white angarkha, mustard dhoti, simple cream shawl and turban with palm-leaf plans and measuring rod stands beside a broad-shouldered Maharana Kumbha in deep maroon quilted coat, green lower garment, red turban and brown-leather-belted talwar.
sheet_prompt: Draw an anime-style full-body model sheet showing two fixed characters together: Sutradhar Jaita and Maharana Kumbha, standing side by side at Chittor Fort in mid-15th century Rajasthan. Jaita is a wiry man who looks in his mid-40s, with an oval face, wheatish complexion, neat trimmed mustache and sharp, thoughtful eyes, his default expression calm and focused. His black hair is medium-length, pulled into a low knot under a simple off-white turban with a thin red border. He wears a long off-white cotton angarkha tied diagonally with faint cream stripe texture, over a light mustard-yellow cotton dhoti wrapped to his ankles, secured with a plain brown woven cloth belt, and a soft, loose cream cotton shawl with a thin red edge over one shoulder. His feet are bare or in simple brown leather sandals, and his only jewellery is a small copper bangle on his right wrist. His signature props are a rolled palm-leaf architectural plan held in one hand and a slender wooden measuring rod tucked into his belt. Beside him, Maharana Kumbha appears as a broad-shouldered warrior-king in his early 30s, with a square jaw, slightly deeper brown complexion, full mustache, short beard, and a steady, commanding yet composed expression. His black hair is tied in a short warrior’s knot under a red Rajput turban with a golden band and a single modest white feather on the left. He wears a knee-length deep maroon quilted cotton coat with subtle vertical quilting and gold piping at the edges over a pale ivory cotton kurta, a deep green cotton jama-style lower garment flaring to mid-calf over off-white tight churidar-style trousers, and a broad dark brown leather belt with a simple brass buckle and small knife sheath. He has soft brown leather boots to mid-calf with slightly curved toes, and a light ochre woolen shawl with a thin green border draped over his shoulders, leaving his sword arm free. His jewellery is modest: gold kadas on both wrists, a thin gold chain with a small round pendant, and small gold stud earrings. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Rajput talwar with a brown leather scabbard and brass fittings, worn at his left hip, his hand resting lightly on the hilt. Emphasize consistent anime-style proportions, clear facial features, exact hairstyles, the off-white, deep maroon, mustard yellow, deep green and brown leather colour palette, and ensure both are fully clothed in historically plausible mid-15th century Mewar garments.
